title: This came in NUST NET 2023. Most get it wrong.
caption:
2¹⁰ = 1024, so the maths is right. The answer is still wrong, because scientific notation means one digit before the decimal and a power of ten. So 1.024 × 10³.

This one came up in NUST NET 2023.
